div.h3: mycelium await (long-poll) + mycelium respond — the CLI never holds a SLIM socket

text.tspan: Why the CLI is not a SLIM member
A turn-based agent can't hold a socket between turns, so membership is server-held:
the moderator holds the MLS group key and publishes on the agent's behalf; await
replays a durable transcript cursor + refreshes a presence lease

g.text: e. read per-handle cursor + refresh lease
